data.name: Infinite Tanks
data.detailed_description:
Infinite Tanks (Tanques Infinitos) oferece exatamente o que o nome sugere: um conteúdo enorme, linhas ilimitadas de veículos de combate modernos, ambientes imensos com condições atmosféricas realistas, missões multijogador online e um sem-fim de missões individuais e exercícios.

Infinite Tanks (Tanques Infinitos) também moderniza o género da simulação de tanques ao dar aos jogadores a capacidade para conceberem e modernizarem os seus próprios veículos impenetráveis, permitindo-lhes sentarem-se verdadeiramente no lugar do condutor. O jogo apresenta um sistema de construção inovador acionado por cartões, o qual permite aos jogadores misturar, combinar e trocar peças individuais dos tanques, incluindo motores, chassis, lagartas, torres, minas, morteiros, expansões e, naturalmente, canhões, a fim de criarem um leque incrivelmente diversificado de veículos potentes e versáteis.

Infinite Tanks (Tanques Infinitos) quebra as barreiras com gráficos modernos e uma jogabilidade excecionalmente complexa.

Características

Sistema de construção exclusivo acionado por cartões, dinamizado pela progressão no modo individual e a colaboração multijogador.
Centenas de milhões de diferentes combinações de veículos, bem como personalização estética, como pinturas e acessórios.
Tanques, destruidores, hovercrafts e lança-foguetes, cada um com 3 classes diferentes.
360 exercícios com ação rápida e intensa.
Campanha vasta e épica no modo individual.
Diferentes ambientes, desde desertos sob um sol escaldante até áreas urbanas densas, com espaço expansivo para jogabilidade e exploração.
Jogos personalizados, incluindo Rei da Colina, Capturar as Bases e Deathmatch em Equipa, tanto online como offline.

60 níveis de progressão, as classes de tanques mais variadas e um impressionante arsenal de armas e projéteis.
Realismo incrível: condições atmosféricas variáveis, sol a atravessar o céu, física realista e sistema de danos.

reviews.review:
Infinite Tanks is a refreshing take on the armored warfare genre, blending accessible arcade combat with an unexpectedly deep vehicle construction system. Developed and published by Atypical Games, the title moves beyond simply placing players behind the controls of famous military vehicles. Instead, it emphasizes creativity by allowing players to assemble their own tanks from a massive collection of interchangeable parts. This design philosophy gives the game a distinctive identity, offering a satisfying balance between fast-paced action and strategic customization that keeps progression engaging over the long term.

The centerpiece of the experience is its extensive tank-building system. Players unlock parts through a collectible card mechanic, gradually expanding a garage filled with engines, hulls, turrets, suspension systems, hover technology, weaponry, armor upgrades, and cosmetic options. Rather than following a straightforward upgrade path, every newly acquired component opens fresh opportunities for experimentation. A heavily armored assault tank, a speedy reconnaissance vehicle, or a missile-equipped hovercraft can all be built depending on personal preference. This flexibility gives players considerable freedom to create vehicles that complement their preferred combat style while encouraging constant experimentation throughout the campaign.

Combat itself strikes an enjoyable balance between realism and accessibility. Battles are easy to understand but become increasingly tactical as stronger enemies and more complex objectives are introduced. Success often depends on intelligent positioning, proper use of terrain, and selecting the right vehicle configuration for each mission. Different weapon types perform well under different circumstances, making thoughtful preparation just as important as accurate shooting. The variety of enemy encounters, combined with responsive controls and satisfying explosions, ensures that firefights remain entertaining even after many hours of play.

The single-player campaign offers a generous amount of content supported by numerous missions and combat exercises that steadily introduce new mechanics and equipment. Rather than overwhelming players immediately, the game gradually expands the available customization options while presenting increasingly demanding objectives. This steady progression creates a rewarding gameplay loop where every completed mission contributes toward building stronger and more specialized vehicles. The additional combat challenges also provide opportunities to master different weapon systems and refine vehicle designs beyond the main storyline.

Battlefields are impressively varied, featuring deserts, forests, industrial facilities, and urban environments that encourage different tactical approaches. Wide-open areas reward long-range engagements and heavy firepower, while tighter maps promote flanking maneuvers and close-quarters combat. Dynamic lighting, changing weather conditions, and attractive environmental effects enhance the visual presentation without distracting from gameplay. Vehicle models are detailed, explosions feel impactful, and the battlefield atmosphere successfully captures the intensity of mechanized warfare.

Multiplayer extends the game's lifespan by offering several competitive modes, including Team Deathmatch, King of the Hill, and Capture the Base. The extensive customization system becomes even more enjoyable when facing other players, as no two tanks are necessarily built the same way. Offline skirmishes and custom matches also provide flexibility for players who prefer practicing against AI opponents or experimenting with new vehicle builds before entering competitive matches. The diversity of player-created machines keeps multiplayer encounters unpredictable and encourages continual refinement of custom designs.

Infinite Tanks is not without its shortcomings. Enemy artificial intelligence can occasionally behave inconsistently, and some balancing issues may become apparent as players discover particularly effective combinations of components. Those seeking an authentic military simulation may also find the arcade-inspired mechanics less grounded than traditional tank simulators. However, these limitations do little to diminish the game's core strengths, as its emphasis on creativity and customization ultimately sets it apart from many competitors in the genre.

Overall, Infinite Tanks succeeds by offering much more than straightforward armored combat. Its deep construction mechanics, satisfying progression system, enjoyable campaign, varied environments, and entertaining multiplayer modes combine to create an experience that remains engaging well beyond the opening hours. The freedom to design personalized combat vehicles gives every player the opportunity to approach battles differently, making each victory feel uniquely earned. It stands as an excellent choice for players who appreciate both vehicle customization and explosive action wrapped into one polished package.

Rating: 6/10
